description: The digital root of a decimal integer. Zero stays zero, and any other magnitude is 1 + (n-1) mod 9, so multiples of 9 have root 9. The sign is ignored. A malformed integer is rejected. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/digital-root
name: digital_root
title: Digital Root
